chunks: 3341 - The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
“Whoever swears to you by Allah regarding a right, then believe him; and whoever asks you by Allah, then give him. The oath has removed the claimant’s claim, and there is no claim left for him.”

key_terms.بِاللَّهِ: by Allah; invoking the Divine Name as an oath or plea
key_terms.فَصَدِّقُوهُ: then affirm him or believe him

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about accepting an oath by Allah and the legal effect of an oath on a claimant’s case?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches respect for oaths made in the Name of Allah and encourages responding generously to one who asks by Allah. It also conveys a legal principle concerning claims and oaths, indicating that the oath can determine the outcome of a claim.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3341 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said:

"Whoever swears to you by Allah (swt) regarding a right, then believe him, and whoever asks you in the name of Allah (swt), then give him. The oath is for the claimant, and there is no claim for him without it."
